title: Kobe Bryant's Muse
historical_context: Released during Bryant's injury-limited final playing years.
why_it_matters: First long-form self-examination of his playing life and relationships; credit distinguishes Bryant from the film's director.
verification_note: Granity gives February 2015, not an exact day.

title: Dear Basketball (animated film)
creator_or_speaker: Kobe Bryant; Glen Keane; John Williams
historical_context: Adapts Bryant's 2015 retirement poem after the end of his NBA career.
why_it_matters: Marks the move from player-authored text into film and later Academy recognition.
verification_note: Granity gives December 2017; Keane directed and illustrated, Williams composed.

title: The Punies
historical_context: Bryant developed youth-oriented stories after retirement.
why_it_matters: Shows his educational storytelling focus beyond basketball; Haller is credited as writer.
verification_note: Granity gives August 2018 and explicit creator/writer credits.

title: The Mamba Mentality: How I Play
historical_context: Published after Bryant's retirement alongside his Granity projects.
why_it_matters: Book-length first-person explanation of preparation, technique, opponents, and leadership.
verification_note: Publisher provides on-sale date and separates author from photographer.

title: DETAIL
historical_context: Bryant began producing basketball analysis for an audience after retirement.
why_it_matters: His film-study method became an authored audiovisual series.
verification_note: ESPN series page confirms title; Granity confirms 2018 release and Bryant creator/writer credits.

title: The Wizenard Series: Training Camp
historical_context: Granity expanded into young-adult sports fiction.
why_it_matters: Makes Bryant's performance and mentorship themes explicit through a team narrative while preserving the writer credit.
verification_note: Granity confirms the work and credit split; Kirkus author catalog gives March 19 2019 publication date: https://www.kirkusreviews.com/author/kobe-bryant/ .

title: Legacy and the Queen
historical_context: Granity extended its sports fantasy line to tennis.
why_it_matters: Shows Bryant's creative interests beyond basketball and his collaborative authorship model.
verification_note: Granity confirms the work; Kirkus author catalog gives September 3 2019 publication date and Annie Matthew credit: https://www.kirkusreviews.com/author/kobe-bryant/ .

title: Epoca: The Tree of Ecrof
historical_context: Granity developed a fantasy sports academy series.
why_it_matters: Documents the breadth of his late creative program and distinguishes concept credit from prose authorship.
verification_note: Granity confirms the work; Kirkus author catalog gives November 12 2019 publication date and Ivy Claire credit: https://www.kirkusreviews.com/author/kobe-bryant/ .

title: Legacy and the Double
kobe_role: original creator; Annie Matthew wrote text
historical_context: Released after Bryant's death as a sequel to Legacy and the Queen.
why_it_matters: Tracks continuation of a Bryant-created world without falsely attributing the posthumous prose to him.
verification_note: Granity explicitly provides release day and credit split.

title: The Wizenard Series: Season One
kobe_role: original creator; Wesley King wrote text
historical_context: Published after Bryant's death as a follow-up to Training Camp.
why_it_matters: Continues the basketball mentorship world while keeping the posthumous writing credit distinct from Bryant's original concept.
verification_note: Granity lists the sequel; Kirkus author catalog gives March 31 2020 date and Wesley King credit: https://www.kirkusreviews.com/author/kobe-bryant/ .

title: Geese Are Never Swans
kobe_role: original creator; Eva Clark wrote text
historical_context: Published after Bryant's death and set in competitive swimming.
why_it_matters: Expands his youth-sport fiction into grief and athlete mental health without attributing the prose to Bryant.
verification_note: Granity describes the work; Kirkus author catalog gives July 21 2020 date and Eva Clark credit: https://www.kirkusreviews.com/author/kobe-bryant/ .

title: Epoca: The River of Sand
kobe_role: original creator; Ivy Claire wrote text
historical_context: Published after Bryant's death as the second Epoca book.
why_it_matters: Tracks continuation of the sports fantasy project and the limit of Bryant's direct participation.
verification_note: Granity lists the sequel; Kirkus author catalog gives December 15 2020 date and Ivy Claire credit: https://www.kirkusreviews.com/author/kobe-bryant/ .

title: Canvas: Guarding the Greats
historical_context: Bryant began an ESPN Canvas series after retirement with a film about defending elite players.
why_it_matters: The first installment shows how he transferred detailed film study into authored visual instruction.
verification_note: ESPN's March 2017 report states the first Canvas piece aired on Christmas Day and gives its running time; this URL is an ESPN description rather than a standalone video page.

title: Canvas City: Musecage
historical_context: Bryant expanded the Canvas series into a longer animated teaching project aired on NBA Countdown.
why_it_matters: The piece joins tactical analysis with a fictional world, music, puppetry, and his stated educational aims.
verification_note: ESPN's contemporaneous feature describes the March 26 debut and embeds part of the project; standalone full-video access not established.
